scope: The proposed K503 lower-word-norm route when evidence is taken from one fixed finite-dimensional K162 exterior approximant.

theorem.continuum_boundary: The K162 cofinal limit may have nonzero words at every level; K504 does not assert continuum termination.
theorem.fixed_approximant_consequence: Every fixed finite one-particle approximant has a finite total occupation ceiling, so it cannot carry a strictly positive lower bound for ||G^n phi|| at all n.
theorem.invalid_inference: Finite-level positivity on one regulator, even at every level below its rank ceiling, is not an all-level continuum lower envelope.
theorem.rank_ceiling: In Gamma_-(H_1 direct-sum ... direct-sum H_s), a word with more than dim(H_i) creations in species i is exactly zero.
theorem.valid_order_of_limits: An all-level native lower envelope must be proved on the continuum carrier, or with estimates uniform in refinement before n tends to infinity.
